sentences.text: Bayu memperlambat mobil karena ada tikungan tajam di depan.
sentences.en: Bayu slowed the car because there was a sharp bend ahead.
sentences.ko: 앞에 급커브가 있어서 바유는 차 속도를 줄였어요.

sentences.text: Intan melukis jalan pegunungan dengan banyak tikungan yang berliku.
sentences.en: Intan painted a mountain road full of winding bends.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 굽이굽이 커브가 많은 산길을 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Bagasi mobil Bayu penuh dengan barang bawaan teman-temannya.
sentences.en: The trunk of Bayu's car was full of his friends' luggage.
sentences.ko: 바유의 차 트렁크는 친구들의 짐으로 가득 찼어요.

sentences.text: Bakat menggambar itu tampaknya bawaan dari ibu Intan.
sentences.en: That drawing talent seems to have come from Intan's mother.
sentences.ko: 그 그림 재능은 인탄의 어머니에게서 물려받은 것 같아요.

sentences.text: Dari tebing, Bayu melihat menara suar berdiri di ujung tanjung.
sentences.en: From the cliff, Bayu saw a lighthouse standing at the tip of the cape.
sentences.ko: 절벽에서 바유는 곶 끝에 서 있는 등대를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Untuk tugas melukis laut, Intan menambahkan cahaya suar di kejauhan.
sentences.en: For the seascape assignment, Intan added a beacon light in the distance.
sentences.ko: 바다 그리기 과제에서 인탄은 멀리 등댓불을 그려 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Sejak kecil Bayu ingin berpetualang menyusuri pantai dengan mobil sendiri.
sentences.en: Since he was little, Bayu has wanted to go on an adventure along the coast in his own car.
sentences.ko: 바유는 어릴 때부터 자기 차로 해안을 따라 모험하고 싶었어요.

sentences.text: Guru mengajak Intan berpetualang dengan warna yang belum pernah ia pakai.
sentences.en: The teacher encouraged Intan to be adventurous with colors she had never used.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 인탄에게 한 번도 안 써 본 색으로 모험해 보라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Bayu dan teman-temannya menuju pantai di sebelah tenggara pulau.
sentences.en: Bayu and his friends headed for a beach on the southeast side of the island.
sentences.ko: 바유와 친구들은 섬 남동쪽에 있는 해변으로 향했어요.

sentences.text: Jendela di sisi tenggara kelas memberi cahaya pagi yang disukai Intan.

sentences.text: Bayu kesulitan memarkir mobil di jalan sempit dekat pasar.
sentences.en: Bayu had trouble parking the car on the narrow road near the market.
sentences.ko: 바유는 시장 근처 좁은 길에 차를 대느라 애먹었어요.

sentences.text: Intan terlambat ke kelas lukis karena susah memarkir motornya.
sentences.en: Intan was late to painting class because it was hard to park her scooter.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 오토바이를 대기 힘들어서 미술 수업에 늦었어요.

sentences.text: Bayu ingin menjelajah desa-desa kecil yang tidak ada di brosur wisata.
sentences.en: Bayu wants to explore small villages that aren't in the tourist brochures.
sentences.ko: 바유는 관광 안내서에 없는 작은 마을들을 둘러보고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Di kelas ini, Intan bebas menjelajah berbagai teknik cat air.
sentences.en: In this class, Intan is free to explore various watercolor techniques.
sentences.ko: 이 수업에서 인탄은 여러 수채화 기법을 마음껏 탐구할 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Teman-teman Bayu menyebut perjalanan mereka sebagai ekspedisi mencari sate terenak.
sentences.en: Bayu's friends call their trip an expedition to find the tastiest satay.
sentences.ko: 바유의 친구들은 이번 여행을 가장 맛있는 사테를 찾는 탐험이라고 불러요.

sentences.text: Intan menggambar ulang foto ekspedisi lama ke kutub dari sebuah buku.
sentences.en: Intan redrew an old photo of a polar expedition from a book.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 책에 실린 옛 극지 탐험 사진을 다시 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Bayu membunyikan klakson pelan saat seekor kambing menyeberang jalan.
sentences.en: Bayu gave a light honk when a goat crossed the road.
sentences.ko: 염소가 길을 건너자 바유는 경적을 살짝 울렸어요.

sentences.text: Suara klakson dari jalan raya membuat Intan sulit berkonsentrasi.
sentences.en: The sound of car horns from the main road made it hard for Intan to concentrate.
sentences.ko: 큰길의 경적 소리 때문에 인탄은 집중하기 힘들었어요.

sentences.text: Di perlintasan, Bayu menunggu kereta barang dengan puluhan gerbong lewat.
sentences.en: At the level crossing, Bayu waited for a freight train with dozens of cars to pass.
sentences.ko: 건널목에서 바유는 화차 수십 칸이 달린 화물 열차가 지나가길 기다렸어요.

sentences.text: Intan membuat sketsa gerbong kereta tua di museum.
sentences.en: Intan sketched an old train carriage at the museum.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 박물관에서 낡은 기차 객차를 스케치했어요.

sentences.text: Bayu bertemu rombongan pesepeda motor di rumah makan pinggir jalan.

sentences.text: Satu rombongan murid SD datang melihat pameran karya Intan.

sentences.ko: 초등학생 한 무리가 인탄의 작품 전시를 보러 왔어요.

sentences.text: Dari pelabuhan, Bayu melihat kapal pesiar putih yang besar sekali.
sentences.en: From the harbor, Bayu saw a huge white cruise ship.

sentences.text: Lukisan kapal pesiar karya Intan dipajang di dekat pintu.

sentences.text: Bayu lupa berbelok di persimpangan, jadi mereka harus putar balik.

sentences.text: Garis di lukisan Intan sengaja berbelok tajam di tengah kanvas.
sentences.en: The line in Intan's painting deliberately turns sharply in the middle of the canvas.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 그림 속 선은 캔버스 가운데에서 일부러 급하게 꺾여요.

sentences.text: Bayu memberi jalan kepada pengendara motor yang membawa keranjang sayur.
sentences.en: Bayu gave way to a motorcyclist carrying a basket of vegetables.
sentences.ko: 바유는 채소 바구니를 실은 오토바이 운전자에게 길을 양보했어요.

sentences.text: Intan melukis pengendara sepeda yang melintas di bawah hujan.
sentences.en: Intan painted a cyclist passing by in the rain.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 비 속을 지나가는 자전거 탄 사람을 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Di penginapan, teman Bayu mengocok kartu untuk main sampai larut malam.
sentences.en: At the guesthouse, Bayu's friend shuffled the cards to play until late at night.

sentences.text: Bayu menolak mengebut walaupun jalan tol sedang sepi.

sentences.text: Intan terpaksa mengebut naik motor karena kelas sudah hampir mulai.

sentences.text: Vas tanah liat buatan Intan jatuh dan pecah berkeping-keping.

sentences.text: Guru bilang terlalu banyak warna gelap bisa melemahkan kesan ceria lukisan Intan.

sentences.text: Rencana kejutan untuk ulang tahun Bayu terbongkar karena temannya keceplosan.

sentences.text: Banjir sempat memutus jalan menuju desa, jadi Bayu menunggu di warung.

sentences.text: Bayu memuji loyalitas sahabatnya yang selalu ikut setiap perjalanan.

sentences.text: Toko di pinggir jalan itu menjual barang serba murah untuk para sopir.
sentences.en: That roadside shop sells all kinds of cheap goods for drivers.

sentences.text: Angin laut bertiup kencang saat Bayu berhenti di jembatan.

sentences.ko: 바유는 그날 오후 자전거를 빌려 호수를 한 바퀴 돌았어요.

sentences.text: Setiap Sabtu, Intan bersepeda ke sanggar sambil membawa papan gambar.
sentences.en: Every Saturday, Intan cycles to the studio carrying her drawing board.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 토요일마다 화판을 들고 자전거로 화실에 가요.

sentences.text: Truk kontainer yang berderet di jalan pelabuhan membuat Bayu terjebak macet.
sentences.en: The container trucks lined up on the port road left Bayu stuck in traffic.
sentences.ko: 항구 길에 줄지은 컨테이너 트럭 때문에 바유는 차가 막혀 꼼짝 못 했어요.

sentences.text: Intan menyimpan sisa cat di kontainer plastik bertutup rapat.
sentences.en: Intan keeps leftover paint in a tightly sealed plastic container.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 남은 물감을 뚜껑을 꽉 닫은 플라스틱 통에 보관해요.

sentences.text: Bayu menurunkan temannya di perhentian bus dekat alun-alun.
sentences.en: Bayu dropped his friend off at the bus stop near the town square.
sentences.ko: 바유는 광장 근처 버스 정류장에 친구를 내려 줬어요.

sentences.text: Intan melukis halte tua yang menjadi perhentian terakhir bus kota.
sentences.en: Intan painted an old shelter that is the last stop for the city bus.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 시내버스 종점인 낡은 정류장을 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Sinyal hilang, jadi aplikasi navigasi di ponsel Bayu tidak bisa dipakai.
sentences.en: The signal dropped, so the navigation app on Bayu's phone stopped working.
sentences.ko: 신호가 끊겨서 바유의 휴대폰 내비게이션 앱을 쓸 수 없었어요.

sentences.text: Intan meniru gaya peta navigasi kuno untuk latar belakang lukisannya.
sentences.en: Intan copied the style of ancient navigation charts for her painting's background.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 그림 배경에 옛 항해 지도의 화풍을 따라 했어요.
